description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Galuf)] and [Earth Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Galuf)
description.text: Earth abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Dawn Strikes after using two Earth abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Last Stand], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Earth Mode II (Galuf)] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Galuf)] from the user

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: KO
description.text: Automatically set when HP reaches 0, prevents from acting, counts towards Game Over, persists after battle

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Earth Mode II (Galuf)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Earth abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time, cast speed x2.00, critical chance =100%, grants [Critical Damage +50% 1] to all allies after using Earth abilities

description.name: Critical Damage +50% 1
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Dual Dawn Strikes
description.text: Four single attacks (1.02 each), 100% hit rate, causes [Imperil Earth 10% (15s)]

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3
